question: Does asking for a consequential decision only when observed rankings disagree preserve earlier deployable quality and final performance compared with unconditional early Flash and the unchanged planner?
baseline: dbb19b8 research planner, promoted calibration and protected incumbent. The public course submission remains d501807.
cases: s51 new noisy curved numeric boundary, seed 26051, balanced accuracy
s52 UCI 331 IMDb review sentences, previous training history from the prior study excluded these sentences, macro F1
s53 new conditional nominal labels, seed 26053, macro F1
s54 new shifted noisy directional textures, seed 26054, accuracy
outer: Stratified 25% after duplicate/conflict removal, fixed random state 112557. A public source may have appeared in other research. No course designated validation or formal test. Generate all packets before new training. No outer scores available until all available final and fourth-trial predictions are sealed.
common: All three arms run the normal solve and fresh-process predict entry points. Same candidate generator, folds, seed 18643, 16 actual classifier fits including refits, 600 seconds. Full breadth of search is retained. Freeze the best verified primary checkpoint through the fourth completed trial, or the last available if earlier stop. Compare the final and early declared metrics, row-level changes and actual fits.
change: The new arm protects ongoing primary exploration. After autonomous selection and the existing protected challenge, compare all actually measured individual alternatives against the deliverable incumbent. Seek a review only if two disjoint training folds rank a pair in opposite order, a third disjoint fold can supply new matched evidence, and both measurement and a possible refit are affordable. A request can be declined or name a feasible probe, both evidence folds, and distinct pass/fail action identifiers before its result. Only these two actions are executed: refit/adopt this challenger on a positive third-fold gain and at least 0.003 weighted gain across folds, subject to any stricter proposed threshold, otherwise deliver the saved incumbent. Zero call when no decision can change. Missing, invalid, identical or unattainable branches retain the saved model.
accounting: One paid campus DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash per eligible paid arm; two non-repeatable named arms on one stable cumulative task scope, <=0.12 RMB each, <=0.96 RMB on this panel. Same real marked local outbox. Use genuine usage only, no paid retries; halt new paid dispatch on unknown. Network-off control, offline fit workers. Exclude unavailable comparisons from superiority claims, include missed triggers in reported denominator.
success: All four paired tasks, no final declared-metric loss versus either comparison, and at least one strict improvement in fourth-trial or final metric versus early Flash, with no fourth-trial loss versus control. Report signed paired results, exact prediction equality, exercise of each branch, distinct from a broad generalization claim. No retuning on this panel. Software branch tests must independently exercise adoption, retention, and refusal.
